name: Facet
text: Add a single, prominent button labeled “Live Refresh” that toggles continuous playback of the visualization. This keeps the interface simple while giving users control over performance-heavy updates. The trade-off is that users must manually pause to avoid overwhelming the system during complex interactions.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A single toggle hides the live state—users won’t know if it’s on or off until they trigger a change. Default to paused, with a clear visual cue (e.g., a pulsing border) when live. Settle it with a 5-user usability test: measure how often they miss the live mode vs. how often they’re overwhelmed.
